messages:
tara: Quick thread to align on priority lanes for the next roadmap slice. We have customer asks for per-tenant SLAs and product wants to avoid blocking GA on HSM if possible. Need owners + sequencing.

ravi: Outline perf targets and a proposed rollout.

tara: GA goal: 12k rps peak, p95 < 150ms. Proposal: three lanes - pilot (opt-in), controlled beta (invites), GA. Pilot = 4w, beta = +3w, GA = +4w after security signoff.

jamal: Runtime note: pilot can use shared KV cache + tighter TTLs; beta should add sharded cache prototype. Prewarm counts needed. Owner: runtime for cache and batching.

sofia: Security: GA requires tenant key separation and audited KMS. Pilot/beta can use software keys with strict opt-in and enhanced logging. HSM path is ~3w for infra + audit. Owner: security.

elaine: Product: we'll supply pilot customer list and opt-in consent text. Also want clear rollback criteria.

ravi: Infra will reserve capacity for pilot (6 GPUs) and plan HSM provisioning for GA. I'll open INF ticket and post ETA.

jamal: I'll draft a small runbook with a canary ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% and abort thresholds (error rate > 0.8% or p95 > 2x baseline).

sofia: Add requirement: no GA until KMS rotation and audit pass. Beta can proceed with opt-in software keys but limited to pilot customers.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created INF-9999 "priority-lanes pilot infra" and linked this thread.

tara: Owners recap: tara -> product PRD + pilot list; jamal -> runtime runbook + prewarm config; ravi -> infra ticket + capacity; sofia -> gating checklist + audit plan. Agree?

jamal: Agree :white_check_mark:

sofia: Agree with pilot caveat :white_check_mark:

ravi: Agree. Scheduling 30min sync tomorrow 11am PT to lock timelines.

tara: Thanks — will post PRD link and pilot consent after this thread.
